subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The plants __readily respond to these stimulus.__
solution:
The correct option is - "**readily respond to these stimuli**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The plants **readily respond to these stimuli.**
 
• The word "stimulus" is a singular noun, and the verb "respond" should agree with it in number.
 
• Since the sentence refers to **multiple stimuli**, **the plural form of the noun "stimuli" should be used**.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence would be: "The plants readily respond to these stimuli."
 
• Option 1 provides the correct plural form of the noun and is the most appropriate improvement to the sentence.
 
• Options 2 and 3 are incorrect because they do not agree with the number of the subject, and option 4 is not applicable as the sentence requires improvement.
